The '''old storehouse'''<ref name="jackj">[[Jack's journal]]</ref> is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is situated northeast of [[abandoned mine shaft 2]] and southwest of [[Nuka-World on Tour (location)|Nuka-World on Tour]].

==Background==
[[Jack Woodhouse]], a former member of the [[Blood Eagles]], took up refuge here in September of an undated year. While preparing to try and mine for [[ultracite]], Jack came to this abandoned storehouse and bumped into several [[Crater Raiders|raiders]]. Not wanting to take any risks, Jack killed all of them on the spot. It was only after they were dead that he realized they were not Blood Eagles looking for him. Jack hoped to bury the bodies, but was unable to due to [[mole miner]]s being in the vicinity. On September 10-11, he snuck out and left for [[Abandoned mine shaft 2]].<ref name="jackj">[[Jack's journal]]</ref><ref>[[Ultracite mining journal]]</ref>

==Layout==
This location consists of a warehouse with a good view of the surrounding Ash Heap. A couple of [[raider corpse]]s are on the property, which is surrounded by hills. Inside, the storehouse is largely ruined and filled with rubble. Several [[Lone Wanderer (vehicle)|Lone Wanderer]] motorcycles are littered around the location. An upper floor of the warehouse can be accessed, where there are some containers to be looted.

==Notable loot==
* [[Jack's journal]] - Note, in a box on the second floor, under a [[Gas mask (Fallout 76)|gas mask]] and [[Addictol (Fallout 76)|addictol]].

==Notes==
* Although this location has been in the game since release, Jack's journal was only added with the ''[[Nuka-World on Tour (update)|Nuka-World on Tour]]'' [[Fallout 76 updates|update]].
* This location does not have an entry in the ''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'' [[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia|Atlas of Appalachia]].

==Appearances==
The old storehouse appears only {{In|FO76}}.

The '''Pioneer Scout lookout''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Toxic Valley]] region of [[Appalachia]]. 

==Background==
Pioneer Scout lookout is a watchtower perched on the hillside by [[Pioneer Scout camp|Camp Lewis]]. It was presumably built to keep watch over the lake, to ensure the scouts camping below on the shore of [[Grafton Lake]] did not swim or boat too close to the nearby [[Grafton Dam]] or [[Grafton Steel|Grafton Steel Mill]]. At some point, following the events of the [[Great War]], a raider named [[Bosley]] was contracted to execute a hit on [[Henrick]] by using the watchtower as a vantage point.<ref>[[Bosley's note]]</ref> Conversely, Henrick was set up on the roof of Grafton Steel Mill in order to take out Bosley.<ref>[[Henrick's note]]</ref> The two men ended up killing each other, as evidenced by the corpses directly next to their notes.

==Layout==
This lookout tower overlooks Camp Lewis to the south. The room at the top of the tower contains a [[Bed (Fallout 76)|bed]] with a [[Duffle bag (Fallout 76)|duffle bag]] below it and a locked [[Footlocker (Fallout 76)|footlocker]] at its base. There are also a set of lockers that house a [[First aid (Fallout 76)|first aid]] and a large map of Appalachia on the wall. Bosley's corpse holding a [[Hunting rifle (Fallout 76)|hunting rifle]] sits on the walkway outside, next to a [[Bosley's note|note]] detailing the target he was attempting to snipe. There is also a [[Cooking station (Fallout 76)|cooking station]] on the northern corner of the walkway.

==Notable loot==
* [[Bosley's note]] - Note, next to a raider corpse at the top of the lookout tower.
* [[The Domestics note 3]] - Note, to the northeast, southwest of the butterfly on the world map. It is on a table in an outside living room on a cliff.

==Appearances==
The Pioneer Scout lookout appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''.

ThunderMtPowerPlantExt02-06 |refid ={{ID|00260591}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionSwampForest}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeOutdoors}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} |edid =LocSwampSouthhamptonEstateLocation }} '''Southhampton Estate''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in [[the Mire]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Layout== Southhampton Estate has two buildings: a two-story main house and a neighboring barn. Like most of the buildings in the Mire, the buildings have been overgrown by orange strangler vines. The main house has a kitchen on the lower floor. It contains a fridge, a cooler, and a crate of empty milk bottles in the corner but not much else. The dining table has been upturned and thrown against the wall. Upstairs is a bedroom where [[Ella Ames]]' corpse can be found next to her backpack. A desk with a [[Typewriter (Fallout 76)|typewriter]] is still intact but the bed is not. The barn contains a rusty tractor that no longer works. A few bottles of [[Whiskey (Fallout 76)|whiskey]] can be found in the building as well as a [[Combat shotgun (Fallout 76)|combat shotgun]], corresponding [[Shotgun shell (Fallout 76)|ammunition]], and a locked ammo box ([[Picklock]] 0) on a shelf next to an upturned rowboat on the second floor. A rusted pickup truck sits outside between the two buildings. ==Notable loot== * [[Ella's research]] - Holotape, can be found on the body of [[Ella Ames]] on the upper floor in the house during [[An Organic Solution]]. * Two potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobbleheads]]: ** On the second floor of the red barn, in the northeast corner of the balcony, on a metal table. ** On the second floor of the house, on the right corner of the bed's headboard. * Two potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazines]]: ** In the house, on the kitchen counter, beside the sink. ** On the lean-to entrance of the red barn, on the ruined metal shelf. * Potential [[Fallout 76 plans|plan]] - On the second floor of the barn. * Potential [[Fallout 76 weapon mods|weapon mod]] - In the house, on the second floor, on the left side of the desk, on the ground. ==Appearances== Southhampton Estate appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== F76 Southampton Estate.png|In the sunlight FO76 Mire vibes 2.png FO76 Mire vibes 1.png {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:The Mire locations]] [[ru:Ферма Саутгемптона]] [[zh:南安普頓大廈]]
